description: This file contains utility functions and configuration management code for OpenWrt, including functions for package handling, configuration loading, user and group management, device partition detection, and system info retrieval.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information if DEBUG variable is set.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Performs XOR operation on multiple hex values of the same length.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to a variable with a separator.

methods.name: list_contains
methods.description: Checks if a list variable contains a specific string.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration using uci_load or returns if IPKG_INSTROOT is set.

methods.name: reset_cb
methods.description: Resets configuration callbacks to no-op functions.

methods.name: package
methods.description: Stub function for package handling.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Creates a new configuration section.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Sets an option in the current configuration section.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Adds an item to a list configuration.

methods.name: config_unset
methods.description: Unsets a configuration option.

methods.name: config_get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value with optional default.

methods.name: get_bool
methods.description: Converts various true/false string values to 1 or 0.

methods.name: config_get_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration value.

methods.name: config_set
methods.description: Sets a configuration option.

methods.name: config_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over configuration sections of a specific type.

methods.name: config_list_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over list items in a configuration section.

methods.name: default_prerm
methods.description: Default pre-removal script for packages.

methods.name: add_group_and_user
methods.description: Adds system groups and users based on package control info.

methods.name: default_postinst
methods.description: Default post-installation script for packages.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other shell scripts from a directory.

methods.name: find_mtd_index
methods.description: Finds MTD partition index by name.

methods.name: find_mtd_part
methods.description: Finds MTD partition device path.

methods.name: find_mmc_part
methods.description: Finds MMC partition device path by name.

methods.name: group_add
methods.description: Adds a system group.

methods.name: group_exists
methods.description: Checks if a system group exists.

methods.name: group_add_next
methods.description: Finds next available GID and adds group.

methods.name: group_add_user
methods.description: Adds a user to a group.

methods.name: user_add
methods.description: Adds a system user.

methods.name: user_exists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists.

methods.name: board_name
methods.description: Retrieves the board name from system info.

methods.name: cmdline_get_var
methods.description: Retrieves a variable value from kernel command line.
